gold_note: Coelurosaur cladogram. Internal labels: Maniraptoriformes, Maniraptora and Deinonychosauria (node dots), Coelurosauria and Paraves (stem crosses), and the nine right-hand brackets, each spanning exactly one clade. The ornithomimid, alvarezsaurid, oviraptorosaur, troodontid and dromaeosaurid nodes and polytomies were checked at 2x; support values sit on the lines and do not hide any step. 55 tips, 8 polytomies (5, 3, 3, 3, 5, 3, 3, 9 children); 14 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
